Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art animation atlas for Saltmarrow Deep. Input is the APPROVED Carrion Brood character design reference; faithfully preserve its detailed bone plates, dark plum sinew, moss-green chitin, glowing green spores, dark outlines, rich clustered highlights and menacing organic anatomy. Generate ONLY the specified character. Same upright three-quarter southeast camera in every frame, consistent size and proportions. EXACTLY four columns by five rows, 20 equal square cells; each character fully inside cell, no overlapping cells, generous 15% transparent margin, identical foot/bottom anchor in each cell except collapse. Each virtual pixel is a crisp solid square, no smoothing or blur. Transparent background, no checkerboard, text, labels, borders or scenery. Row1 four subtly DIFFERENT idle breathing poses. Row2 four DIFFERENT walking gait frames with alternating feet and body weight. Row3 four DIFFERENT attack frames: anticipation, windup, strike, recovery. Row4 four DIFFERENT recoil hurt frames. Row5 four DIFFERENT non-graphic defeat frames: stagger, crumple, dry shell collapse, dissolving shell and drifting spores. No blood or organs. Keep important limbs intact inside the cell. Output 1024x1280 or a proportionally equivalent 4:5 image.
